text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to introduce an eastbound stop control on the laneway south of St. Clair Avenue East at Glenfield Crescent, and a westbound stop control on the laneway south of St. Clair Avenue East at Glen Eden Crescent, respectively to clearly establish right-of-way and enhance pedestrian, cyclist and vehicular safety.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized a stop control for eastbound traffic on the laneway south of St. Clair Avenue East at Glenfield Crescent. 2. Authorized a stop control for westbound traffic on the laneway south of St. Clair Avenue East at Glen Eden Crescent.
